threads.body:
"Provider hosting the agent" can be read as the platform that runs the agent. A self-hosted A2A agent on Cloud Run or Azure Container Apps could then get `gcp.gen_ai` or an `azure.*` value, which is the same mislabeled provider value this PR is trying to avoid. Suggest naming the GenAI agent service and ruling out protocol and infrastructure names:

```suggestion
      `gen_ai.provider.name` identifies the GenAI provider of the agent service,
      for example `openai` or `aws.bedrock`. Instrumentation SHOULD NOT set it
      to a protocol name, such as `a2a`, or to the platform that runs a
      self-hosted agent.
```

Please apply the same provider-selection guidance to this metric and regenerate the docs.
